        return str(a) + str(b) == p_str

    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    
    # Fill the dp array
    for i in range(1, n + 1):

            if can_form(int(p_str[j:i]), int(p_str[i:n])):
                dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)

def max_elements(p):
    p_str = str(p)
    n = len(p_str)
    
    # dp[i] will store the maximum number of elements that can form p_str[:i]
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 1  # Base case: an empty string can be formed by 0 elements
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            if p_str[j:i] <= p_str[i:]:
                dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)
    
    return dp[n]
